verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens [docs-37] and role assignment [docs-36], and ships an MCP server an agent could authenticate to [docs-10, docs-11]. The pack gives only page titles, so there is no direct evidence that tokens can be scoped to specific roles, projects or actions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-token role/permission scoping, environment- or project-level restriction for tokens, agent- or MCP-specific credential guidance, and independent corroboration.
